_doc: System P (0.994 framework) with the generalized components of 16/11 (compliance revision): domain-specific prechecks off (size / unit / count / size_use / ticket_avg; their code is removed) and hint_counts off; general consistency checks kept (period, named periods, threshold, len-mask); hide_api industry_metrics (the hand-written industry metrics, one rulebook's definitions, are hidden; general text tools stay); W1 writes the rule cards and shop functions of THIS split's rulebook at run time (units_gen, lrl bind; known_rb train, neutral W1 examples); general Vietnamese retail glossary cards.
